# Badge

A notification badge that anchors a count or status `Tag` at a configurable corner of any child element — typically used for unread counts on icons or buttons.

```ts
import { Badge } from '@wfm/ui-components';
```

## Numeric Count

Use the `count` prop to show a numeric badge. When `count` exceeds `maxCount`, the badge displays a capped value in `+N` format.

- Left: `count={3}` — renders the number directly
- Right: `count={12} maxCount={9}` — count exceeds the cap, displays `9+`

```tsx preview
import { Badge } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex gap="6" padding="4">
      <Badge count={3}>
        <Box
          width="32px"
          height="32px"
          style={{
            background: '#e8f0fe',
            borderRadius: 6,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
          }}
        >
          🔔
        </Box>
      </Badge>
      <Badge count={12} maxCount={9}>
        <Box
          width="32px"
          height="32px"
          style={{
            background: '#e3fcef',
            borderRadius: 6,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
          }}
        >
          📬
        </Box>
      </Badge>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Count Hidden When Zero

When `count={0}` the badge is **automatically hidden** — no extra visibility logic needed.

- Left: `count={0}` — badge is not rendered
- Right: `count={5}` — badge renders normally

```tsx preview
import { Badge } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex gap="6" padding="4">
      <Badge count={0}>
        <Box
          width="32px"
          height="32px"
          style={{
            background: '#f4f5f7',
            borderRadius: 6,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
          }}
        >
          🔕
        </Box>
      </Badge>
      <Badge count={5}>
        <Box
          width="32px"
          height="32px"
          style={{
            background: '#f4f5f7',
            borderRadius: 6,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
          }}
        >
          🔔
        </Box>
      </Badge>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Custom Content

Use the `content` prop to render any `ReactNode` inside the badge. Mutually exclusive with `count` and `maxCount`.

- `content="NEW"` — text label badge

```tsx preview
import { Badge } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex padding="4">
      <Badge content="NEW">
        <Box
          width="64px"
          height="32px"
          style={{
            background: '#e8f0fe',
            borderRadius: 6,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
          }}
        >
          Feature
        </Box>
      </Badge>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Status

Use the `status` prop to control the semantic color of the badge, mapped to Cobalt Tag `color` tokens.

| `status`  | Cobalt `color` | Use case                       |
| --------- | -------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `default` | `light-gray`   | Neutral indicator              |
| `success` | `light-green`  | Success / online               |
| `warning` | `light-yellow` | Warning                        |
| `danger`  | `red`          | Error / critical (**default**) |
| `info`    | `light-blue`   | Informational                  |

```tsx preview
import { Badge } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

const Icon = ({ bg, label }) => (
  <Box
    width="32px"
    height="32px"
    style={{
      background: bg,
      borderRadius: 6,
      display: 'flex',
      alignItems: 'center',
      justifyContent: 'center',
      fontSize: 14,
    }}
  >
    {label}
  </Box>
);

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex gap="8" padding="4" wrap>
      <Badge count={1} status="default">
        <Icon bg="#f4f5f7" label="D" />
      </Badge>
      <Badge count={2} status="success">
        <Icon bg="#e3fcef" label="S" />
      </Badge>
      <Badge count={3} status="warning">
        <Icon bg="#fffae6" label="W" />
      </Badge>
      <Badge count={4} status="danger">
        <Icon bg="#ffebe6" label="!" />
      </Badge>
      <Badge count={5} status="info">
        <Icon bg="#e8f0fe" label="i" />
      </Badge>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Sizes

Use the `size` prop to control badge size. Values map directly to Cobalt Tag size tokens — no abbreviations.

| `size`   | Use case                              |
| -------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `tiny`   | Extra-small icon contexts (16px icon) |
| `small`  | Standard icon contexts (**default**)  |
| `medium` | Medium-sized element contexts         |
| `large`  | Large element contexts                |

```tsx preview
import { Badge } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex gap="8" padding="4" alignY="center">
      <Badge count={9} size="tiny">
        <Box
          width="24px"
          height="24px"
          style={{ background: '#e8f0fe', borderRadius: 6 }}
        />
      </Badge>
      <Badge count={9} size="small">
        <Box
          width="32px"
          height="32px"
          style={{ background: '#e8f0fe', borderRadius: 6 }}
        />
      </Badge>
      <Badge count={9} size="medium">
        <Box
          width="40px"
          height="40px"
          style={{ background: '#e8f0fe', borderRadius: 6 }}
        />
      </Badge>
      <Badge count={9} size="large">
        <Box
          width="48px"
          height="48px"
          style={{ background: '#e8f0fe', borderRadius: 6 }}
        />
      </Badge>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Status → Cobalt color mapping

| WFM `status` | Cobalt Tag `color` |
| ------------ | ------------------ |
| `default`    | `light-gray`       |
| `success`    | `light-green`      |
| `warning`    | `light-yellow`     |
| `danger`     | `red`              |
| `info`       | `light-blue`       |

## Badge Positioning

Use `gapX` and `gapY` to offset the badge from the child element's corner. Use `originPosition` and `directionPosition` (both `CardinalPoint`) to change which corner of the child the badge anchors to and which direction it floats.

- Default: `originPosition="NE"` / `directionPosition="NW"` — badge sits at the top-right corner
- `originPosition="SE"` / `directionPosition="SW"` — badge moves to the bottom-right corner
- `gapY={0}` — reduces vertical gap so the badge sits flush with the edge

```tsx preview
import { Badge, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

const Icon = ({ bg }: { bg: string }) => (
  <Box
    width="40px"
    height="40px"
    style={{
      background: bg,
      borderRadius: 8,
      display: 'flex',
      alignItems: 'center',
      justifyContent: 'center',
      fontSize: 20,
    }}
  >
    🔔
  </Box>
);

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex gap="10" padding="8" alignY="center" wrap>
      <Flex direction="column" gap="2" alignX="center">
        <Badge count={3} status="danger">
          <Icon bg="#e8f0fe" />
        </Badge>
        <Typography variant="caption">default (NE/NW)</Typography>
      </Flex>

      <Flex direction="column" gap="2" alignX="center">
        <Badge
          count={5}
          status="success"
          originPosition="SE"
          directionPosition="SW"
        >
          <Icon bg="#e3fcef" />
        </Badge>
        <Typography variant="caption">SE/SW (bottom-right)</Typography>
      </Flex>

      <Flex direction="column" gap="2" alignX="center">
        <Badge
          count={2}
          status="info"
          originPosition="NW"
          directionPosition="NE"
        >
          <Icon bg="#f4f5f7" />
        </Badge>
        <Typography variant="caption">NW/NE (top-left)</Typography>
      </Flex>

      <Flex direction="column" gap="2" alignX="center">
        <Badge count={7} status="warning" gapX={4} gapY={0}>
          <Icon bg="#fffae6" />
        </Badge>
        <Typography variant="caption">gapX=4 gapY=0</Typography>
      </Flex>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop                | Type                                                        | Default      | Description                                            |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `status`            | `'default' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger' \| 'info'` | `'danger'`   | Semantic status — controls Cobalt Tag color            |
| `size`              | `'tiny' \| 'small' \| 'medium' \| 'large'`                  | `'tiny'`     | Cobalt Tag size token                                  |
| `count`             | `number`                                                    | —            | Numeric count (hidden when 0)                          |
| `maxCount`          | `number`                                                    | `9`          | Cap value; shows `+N` when exceeded                    |
| `content`           | `ReactNode`                                                 | —            | Custom badge content (mutually exclusive with `count`) |
| `gapX`              | `number`                                                    | `0`          | Horizontal offset in px                                |
| `gapY`              | `number`                                                    | `12`         | Vertical offset in px                                  |
| `originPosition`    | `CardinalPoint`                                             | `'NE'`       | Anchor point on the child                              |
| `directionPosition` | `CardinalPoint`                                             | `'NW'`       | Direction the badge floats toward                      |
| `data-qa`           | `string`                                                    | —            | QA selector attribute                                  |
| `data-component`    | `string`                                                    | `'WFMBadge'` | Component identifier                                   |
